searchText: 🚨 Minimal Viable Kurtosis achieved: https://gist.github.com/shemnon/3854a75448dff222b04a09909ad1394c However... EEST execute causes Nethermind to fork off. Not sure why yet. ``` uv run execute remote \ --fork=Osaka \ --rpc-endpoint=http://<kurtosis-json-rpc>/ \ --rpc-seed-key 04b9f63ecf84210c5366c66d68fa1f5da1fa4f634fad6dfc86178e4d79ff9e59 \ --rpc-chain-id 3151908 \ tests/osaka/eip7692_eof_v1/eip3540_eof_v1/test_execution_function.py ``` EEST tests are also not all execute friendly. From not deploying test contracts to transaction gas limits, we will need to do some cleanup before we can turn it into a spammor. (I cannot get blockscout to work in the MVK, so debugging it is a bit hard) I just realized why EEST execute is having so many failures... all of the deploy contract wrappers are all in legacy mode. So if a pre-positioned contract needs to be an EOF contract it's not getting deployed properly.
